sections.content: You know the future from A2 Unit 19 and *ir a* + infinitive from A1 Unit 25. Here you use both to talk about career plans: the future for a plan or a prediction (El año que viene buscaré un trabajo nuevo) and *ir a* + infinitive for something already decided (Voy a cambiar de carrera).

items.spanish: El año que viene buscaré un trabajo nuevo.
items.english: Next year I will look for a new job.
I am going to change careers.
I want to work in research.

sections.content: *Ir a* + infinitive often sounds closer and more decided; the future sounds more like a plan or a promise.
